quotes.text: We had a great time kayaking! Our guide Ranger did an awesome job educating us about all the exciting things in the Indian river.
What a way to spend our 29th Anniversary!! Thanks guys for making it fun. Though we would have liked some engines on the kayaks we had a great time!
Book yours now! Maggie and Noah were so great! The bio was truly magical!
We had a blast! The crew was awesome and had plenty of fun facts about the bio.
